questions.prompt: Put the T568B colours in order, pin 1 to pin 8.
questions.explanation: This is the most common order used for straight-through cables.

questions.prompt: A computer connects to a switch. Which cable do you make?
choices: Crossover (T568A one end, T568B the other)
questions.explanation: Different device types use straight-through. Auto-MDIX also handles most other cases.

questions.prompt: The cable tester shows light 3 on one end and light 6 on the other. What happened?
choices: Two wires are swapped on one end
questions.explanation: Lights out of order mean wires are crossed. Re-terminate that end.

questions.prompt: Why must the outer jacket go inside the connector?
choices: So the crimp grips it and protects the wires when the cable is pulled
questions.explanation: That strain relief stops the wires breaking off the contacts.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum recommended length of one Ethernet cable run?
questions.explanation: Cat5e and Cat6 Ethernet runs are specified up to 100 metres.
